players.bio: Alexandros Katranis (born 4 May 1998) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake.
Ariath Deng Piol (born 11 October 2004) is an Australian footballer who plays as a striker for Real Salt Lake in Major League Soccer.

Chukwuemeka Somto "Emeka" Eneli (born October 18, 1999) is an American soccer player who plays for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. Career Youth and college Eneli was born in Lansing, Michigan, but moved to Dublin, Ohio was he was eight years old. He attended Dublin Coffman High School, where he played one year of varsity soccer.
Orlando City SC has signed midfielder Colin Guske to a First Team contract through 2027 with a Club option in 2028, from Orlando City B. Guske’s First Team contract will take effect on Jan. 1, 2025.

DeAndre Roselle Yedlin (born July 9, 1993) is an American professional footballer who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. Primarily a right-back, Yedlin has also featured as a right wing-back and wide midfielder.

Diego Angel Luna (born September 7, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. Club career Born in Sunnyvale, California, Luna began his career with the Palo Alto Soccer Club before joining the youth setup at Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes in 2015.
Dominik Marczuk (born 1 November 2003) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a right winger or right wing-back for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake and the Poland national team.
Griffin Dillon (born April 25, 2003) is an American soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Real Salt Lake in the MLS.
Jesús Rafael Barea Barroso (born 28 April 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake.
Juan José Arias Henao is a 22-year-old Colombian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Major League Soccer (MLS) club Real Salt Lake.

Juan Manuel Sanabria Magole (born 29 March 2000) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or left-back for MLS Club Real Salt Lake and the Uruguay national team. Club career Sanabria was born in Florida, and joined Nacional's youth setup in 2012 from hometown side Club Nacional de Florida.

Justen Thomas Glad (born February 28, 1997) is an American soccer player who currently plays as a defender for Real Salt Lake in Major League Soccer. Career Professional Glad joined the Real Salt Lake Arizona Academy in 2012. On April 7, 2014, Glad signed a homegrown contract with Real Salt Lake, making him the seventh homegrown signing in club history.

Kobi Joseph Henry (born April 26, 2004) is a professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake, on loan from Reims B. Born in the United States, he represents the Trinidad and Tobago national team.
Lukas Ahlefeld Engel (born 14 December 1998) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left midfielder for Real Salt Lake.

Mason James Stajduhar (born December 2, 1997) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for USL Championship club Las Vegas Lights, on loan Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. Career Orlando City On November 9, 2015, Orlando City announced the signing of Stajduhar to a Homegrown contract. He became the club's fourth homegrown player.
Morgan Bono Guilavogui (born 10 March 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. Born in France, he plays for the Guinea national team.

Noel Caliskan (born 29 August 2000) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder . Youth, college and amateur career At the youth level, Caliskan played with the academy team of 1. FC Köln between 2012 and 2017, before spending two seasons with the youth team of Fortuna Düsseldorf between 2017 and 2019.

Pablo Mastroeni (born August 29, 1976) is an Argentine born American soccer coach and former player who is the head coach of Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. He was formerly head coach of the Colorado Rapids, and assistant coach of the Houston Dynamo.

Pablo Enrique Ruiz (born December 20, 1998) is an Argentine-Chilean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer side Real Salt Lake. Pablo Enrique Ruiz (born December 20, 1998) is an Argentine-Chilean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer side Real Salt Lake.
Philip Kane Quinton (born November 16, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Real Salt Lake in Major League Soccer.
Rafael Cabral Barbosa (born 20 May 1990), known as Rafael Cabral or simply Rafael, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Real Salt Lake.

Samuel Junqua (born November 9, 1996) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. Career Youth & College Junqua attended the University of California, Berkeley, where he played college soccer for four years between 2015 and 2018, making 68 appearances and tallying 3 assists. He was named to the 2018 All-Pac-12 third team.
Sergi Solans Ormo (born 26 March 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Real Salt Lake.

Stijn Spierings (born 12 March 1996) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake. Born in Alkmaar, Spierings began his youth career and professional career with his local team AZ. Having broken into the first team he played on just two occasions in his first season, against PSV and Excelsior.
Taylor Anthony Booth (born May 31, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Twente and the United States national team.

Tyler Wolff is an American professional winger who currently plays for USL Championship side Sacramento Republic FC, on loan from Major League Soccer (MLS) club Real Salt Lake. Born in Snellville, Georgia, Wolff began his career in the youth academy at the Columbus Crew. In 2019, Wolff joined the academy at Atlanta United.
Victor Oluyemi Olatunji (born 5 September 1999) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake.

Chadwick Zachary Booth (born February 17, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer side Real Salt Lake, on loan from Eredivisie side Excelsior.
